has_own_site_note: Only a Square Online subdomain exists (judith-laguna.square.site), a JS-rendered SPA. Static curl only returns the page shell, but the embedded window.__BOOTSTRAP_STATE__ JSON was extracted directly and yielded real, first-party data (see below).
instagram_source: Read directly from the Square site's own bootstrap JSON: siteData.snapshot.properties.social contains {icon:'instagram', user:'judithmlc_massage'}. This is a first-party, high-confidence source (the business owner's own site settings), not a search-result guess. The task's candidate handles (@laguna_holistic, @judith.beautystudio, @judithbeautystudio) were all checked and ruled out: judith.beautystudio/judithbeautystudio belong to a different, unrelated business in Miami Lakes, FL (confirmed via WebSearch, ~14 miles from this address).
instagram_photos_note: The confirmed handle @judithmlc_massage was queried via scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway service, then local Playwright fallback). The service reached Instagram without a login-wall (login_wall:false) but returned only 1 result, a generic Instagram UI/empty-profile placeholder asset (static.cdninstagram.com/rsrc.php/.../....webp, not a real post). The account appears to have no publicly retrievable posts (empty, inactive, or effectively private to logged-out viewers). No IG-sourced photos were used on the site; the IG link is still included as a real, confirmed contact channel.
facebook_note: Also present in the same Square bootstrap social array but as a malformed/incomplete URL fragment (not a real, resolvable link). facebook.com/JudithMLC returns only Facebook's own login wall, so this could not be independently verified. Not used anywhere on the site.
language_source: Square site's own bootstrap JSON reports siteData.site.properties.language = 'es_US' (the business owner's own site is configured in Spanish), consistent with the West Flagler St / Fountainebleau, Miami market and the owner's Spanish name. Used as the primary/default site language.

hours_note: Two independent listings (Fresha-derived WebSearch snippet and the Yahoo Local/Yelp-syndicated listing) gave mutually INCONSISTENT hours for the same business. sin_testimonios_note: No Google rating/review count exists for this specific business; the only rating in the area belongs to the shared multi-tenant building (My Suite @ Beauty Square) and was correctly NOT attributed to this individual tenant. All star/rating/data-count markup was removed from hero, strip and experience. The opinions section was replaced with a 'Por que Blossom Therapy and Wellness' 3-card section (Licensed therapist / A suite, not a salon floor / Real technology), each grounded in independently-confirmed facts (license MA97132, Suite 18 private location, LED/lymphatic-drainage/maderotherapy equipment).

photos.method: Given the two prior FAILED attempts on this exact business (ids 4adf379a.../4f98f44c..., 2026-07-21) could not get past a Fresha placeholder image and a login-walled IG handle, a broader source was tried this run: the Yahoo Local business listing (a Yelp-syndicated mirror) for this exact business name/address, which turned out to host ~20 real, business-uploaded photos on s.yimg.com CDN.
photos.curation_notes: Discarded from the 20: 4 pure marketing/promo graphics with text overlays (Jueves 2x1 flyer, Terapias Reductoras flyer, Masaje en Silla flyer, Lymphatic Drainage promo card), 1 duplicate logo graphic, 2 near-duplicates of used photos, and several real-but-clinical/injection-style photos (carboxytherapy/mesotherapy close-ups) judged too medical for the gallery tone. facial-treatment.jpg (client mid-facial) was initially selected but then dropped after visual review: cluttered background (backpack, exposed outlet, mismatched orange wall) fell below the editorial bar of the rest of the set, so it was removed in favor of exterior.jpg for the wide gallery tile.
